name: E2E：双商家试运行造数 → 单批次单审核任务聚合验证
description: 使用两个不同商家(2219662018344/2219635649153)构造试运行数据，验证一个批次只产生一个审核任务，不按商家拆分

steps.description: 打开链路详情页(主图生成链路id=20180)

steps.expression: return (() => { const hasF88 = (document.body.textContent || '').includes('F88'); const url = window.location.href; return { hasF88, url, loaded: hasF88 && url.includes('linkDetail') }; })()

steps.description: F88租户已验证且链路详情页已加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if(!modal) return { open: false }; const title = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-title')?.textContent?.trim(); return { open: true, title }; })()
steps.description: 验证试运行弹窗已打开

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if(!modal) return { uploaded: false, reason: 'no_modal' }; const fileInput = modal.querySelector('input[type=file]'); if(!fileInput) return { uploaded: false, reason: 'no_file_input' }; return { uploaded: false, fileInputFound: true, reason: 'need_file' }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if(!modal) return { filled: false, reason: 'no_modal' }; const taskInput = modal.querySelector('input[placeholder*="任务名称"]'); if(taskInput) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; const taskName = '自动化回归_双商家聚合_' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); setter.call(taskInput, taskName); taskInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); taskInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return { filled: true, taskName }; } return { filled: false, reason: 'no_task_input' }; })()
steps.description: 填写任务名称(带双商家标记)

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if(!modal) return { opened: false }; const selectors = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-selector')); for(const sel of selectors) { const formItem = sel.closest('.ant-form-item'); const label = formItem?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''; if(label.includes('运行类型') || sel.closest('.ant-form-item')?.textContent?.includes('运行类型')) { sel.click(); return { opened: true, label: '运行类型' }; } } if(selectors.length > 0) { selectors[selectors.length - 1].click(); return { opened: true, label: 'last_select' }; } return { opened: false }; })()

return (() => { const options = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option'); for(const opt of options) { const text = (opt.textContent || '').trim(); if(text === '测试') { opt.click(); return { selected: '测试' }; } } if(options.length > 0) { options[0].click(); return { selected: options[0].textContent.trim() }; } return { selected: null }; })()

steps.label: dual-merchant-form-filled
steps.description: 试运行表单已填写完成

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if(!modal) return { submitted: false }; const btns = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')); const submitBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return (t.includes('发起任务运行') || t.includes('发起运行')) && !b.disabled; }); if(submitBtn) { submitBtn.click(); return { submitted: true, buttonText: submitBtn.textContent.trim() }; } return { submitted: false, btnLabels: btns.map(b => b.textContent.trim()).filter(t => t) }; })()

return (() => { const text = document.body.textContent || ''; const isSuccess = text.includes('成功') || text.includes('运行中') || text.includes('已提交'); const hasError = text.includes('失败') || text.includes('错误') || text.includes('请上传'); const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); return { isSuccess, hasError, modalStillOpen: !!modal, pageTextPreview: text.substring(0, 400) }; })()

steps.description: 等待试运行数据处理完成
导航到任务管理页面查看审核任务

steps.expression: return (() => { const text = document.body.textContent || ''; const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); const dualMerchantTasks = []; const allTaskElements = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, .ant-list-item, [class*=task], tr'); for(const el of allTaskElements) { const rowText = (el.textContent || '').trim(); if(rowText.includes('双商家聚合') || rowText.includes('20180')) { const cells = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('td, .ant-list-item-meta-title, span')); dualMerchantTasks.push({ text: rowText.substring(0, 200), cellCount: cells.length }); } } return { today, dualMerchantTaskCount: dualMerchantTasks.length, tasks: dualMerchantTasks.slice(0, 10), pageTextPreview: text.substring(0, 600) }; })()
steps.description: 查找双商家试运行产生的审核任务
核心断言：双商家同批次只产生≤1个审核任务(不按商家拆分)

steps.label: dual-merchant-audit-task-count
steps.description: 审核任务数量验证截图

steps.expression: return (() => { const text = document.body.textContent || ''; const seller1 = '2219662018344'; const seller2 = '2219635649153'; const hasSeller1 = text.includes(seller1); const hasSeller2 = text.includes(seller2); const taskCountPattern = text.match(/共\s*(\d+)\s*[条项]/); const totalFromPage = taskCountPattern ? parseInt(taskCountPattern[1]) : null; return { hasSeller1Data: hasSeller1, hasSeller2Data: hasSeller2, totalFromPage, bothSellersInBatch: hasSeller1 && hasSeller2 }; })()
steps.description: 验证两个商家数据均在批次中

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；链路id=20180(主图生成链路)已配置完整环节和策略；test-fixtures/dual-merchant-trial-data.xlsx已生成(含双商家数据)
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 试运行弹窗Modal结构：下载模板按钮/input[type=file]上传/任务名称input/运行类型Select(正式|测试)/发起任务运行按钮。Excel四列：seller_id/seed_image_url/tao_cate/item_id
riskPoints: 核心验证：1个批次含2个不同seller_id，应只产生1个审核任务
Excel上传后需等待解析完成才能提交
任务管理页面需按链路/任务名称筛选才能定位本次运行产生的任务
_testDesign.businessRule: 一个批次的试运行数据只会产生一个审核任务，不会因为使用不同商家而拆分成多个审核任务（审核任务按批次聚合，不按商家区分）
